chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), he said:

It was written on the seal of Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon them both): 'My expectation of God is good, and of the Trustworthy Prophet, and of the Trustee endowed with grace, and of Al-Husayn and Al-Hasan.'
ai.seo_question: What was inscribed on the seal of Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.)?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the seal of Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.), emphasizing 'husn al-zann' (optimistic faith) as a core spiritual attribute linking the Prophet, the Imams, and the divine. It underscores the Shia theological principle that the Imams serve as the ultimate trustees of God’s mercy, reinforcing the continuity of divine guidance through the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-15 According to the same documentation, Ja’far ibn Muhammad (as-Sadiq) (a.s.) said,
“It was written on the seal of Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.), ‘I am optimistic about God, his trustworthy Prophet (S), his kind Trustee, and Al-Hassan and Al-Husayn.”
